_note: Badge catalog — the four Region 1 Badges (§5.10.1). Rows come from docs/design/catalogs/modifiers.md. A Badge carries the same `hook` + `params` vocabulary as a relic (§7.7) on purpose: §7.3.6 states that type-boost relics, held items, Badges and fields are independent multiplicative terms, so the combat sim resolves all of them through one code path and the distinction that matters — a relic is picked up, a Badge is won — stays in the run layer where it belongs. Region 2 (§5.10.2) arrived with v0.7.3 and Region 3 (§5.10.3) with v0.7.4, each with the Gyms that award them. Names are the games' own (2026-09-24): Koga's Poison Gym gives the Soul Badge and Sabrina's Psychic Gym the Marsh Badge, as in Gen I; the Normal and Fighting Badges take the names of the badges whose art they wear (Plain, Knuckle).

badges.name: Boulder Badge
badges.description: Your Lead takes 1 less damage from every hit.
badges.flavour: Proof of a willpower as hard as rock.

badges.name: Cascade Badge
badges.description: Every manual swap draws you an extra card.
badges.flavour: Proof of a mind that flows around what it cannot break.

badges.name: Hive Badge
badges.description: When your deck runs out and cycles, a 20 % chance of a free copy of a card next turn.
badges.flavour: Proof of patience with small things that add up.

badges.name: Plain Badge
badges.description: The first card you play each turn costs 1 less AP.
badges.flavour: Proof that nothing fancy, done well, beats most things.

badges.name: Volcano Badge
badges.description: Offensive cards costing 3 or more AP deal +20 % damage.
badges.flavour: Proof of a temper worth the wait.

badges.name: Rainbow Badge
badges.description: At turn start, a Lead with a status condition restores 3 HP.
badges.flavour: Proof that a garden grows through anything.

badges.name: Thunder Badge
badges.description: The first Ranged move you play each turn costs 1 less AP.
badges.flavour: Proof of a spark that arrives before the thunder.

badges.name: Soul Badge
badges.description: Applying a status condition to an enemy draws you a card.
badges.flavour: Proof of patience with a slow poison.

badges.name: Marsh Badge
badges.description: Every hidden intent is revealed for the first 2 turns of each combat.
badges.flavour: Proof of a mind that sees what is coming.

badges.name: Earth Badge
badges.description: Step-Forward and Step-Backward moves cost 1 less AP.
badges.flavour: Proof that the ground under you is yours to move on.

badges.name: Knuckle Badge
badges.flavour: Proof of a hundred days of training.

badges.name: Glacier Badge
badges.description: When an enemy gains a status condition, its next attack deals 15 % less damage.
badges.flavour: Proof of a cold that slows everything it touches.
